name: maildotnull Local Email and Provider API Testing
free_limit: MIT-licensed local SMTP testing server with web inbox and emulated Resend, SendGrid and Amazon SES send APIs; no vendor-imposed software usage limit or expiry.
watch_out: Self-host on your own machine or Docker infrastructure; messages are held in memory and the inbox retains at most 1,000 messages. Not a hosted email sending allowance or production mail delivery service.
